errors.text_span: The chart is composed of six slices, arranged in a donut format.
errors.evidence: The figure is a two-ring donut chart with 4 outer slices and 3 inner slices (7 segments total), not six slices.

errors.text_span: These slices are colored blue, light blue, and a pale pink.
errors.evidence: All slices are shades of blue; there is no pale pink slice in the figure.

errors.text_span: The largest slice, colored blue, represents "Std: 0.0" and occupies approximately 38.0% of the chart.
errors.evidence: In the outer ring, Std: 0.0 corresponds to the dark teal slice labeled about 49.0%, not 38.0%.

errors.text_span: Following this is "Std: 0.47", also colored blue, with an estimated 14.2%.
errors.evidence: Std: 0.47 is the outer-ring slice labeled about 39.0%, not 14.2%.

errors.text_span: A light blue slice labeled "Std: 0.82" represents 7.0%, while another light blue slice labeled "Std: 0.94" occupies 7.0% of the donut.
errors.evidence: The outer-ring slices are labeled about 5.0% (Std: 0.82) and 7.0% (Std: 0.94), so the 7.0% assignment to Std: 0.82 is wrong.

errors.text_span: The remaining slices are pale pink; one labeled "Max: 1" occupying approximately 5.0% and the other "Max: 2" with 39.0%.
errors.evidence: The inner-ring categories are not pale pink. Also, Max: 1 is about 47.7%, Max: 2 is about 38.0%, and Max: 3 is about 14.2%—there are three inner slices, not two.
The description omits the visible inner-ring category "Max: 3".

errors.text_span: The light blue slices appear to be ordered from smallest to largest proportion.
errors.evidence: The outer light-blue slices are labeled about 5.0% and 7.0%, but this ordering claim is not supported as a clear visual ordering of all light-blue slices; moreover the sizes are not consistently increasing across the full set.
